fields.gemini:
With reference to your Notice Reference Number: ZA040822001387U, dated 11.08.2022, in which your office asked for Additional Information / Clarification / Documents relating to Application Reference No. AA040822000636L. Following is my submission:

1. Promoters / Partner's Identity Information: Pan Card and Aadhar Card of Proprietor attached with this Letter.

2. Reason for Obtaining Another GST Registration for the Same address: I am taking Casual GST Registration. It is submitted that ,I am engaged in Exhibition & Event Management work, which is planned to be held on 27th and 28th August,2022 at CSJ Infrastructure Pvt Ltd, 178, INDUSTRIAL PARK, PHASE 1, Chandigarh- 160002.

3. Regarding Bank details left blank: I will update the bank details once we get the GST Approval.

Hope that you will find the above explanation satisfactorily and grant us Registration (Casual) as soon as possible because my event is to be held on 27th and 28th August,2022.
